item_name: Rothco All Caliber Gun Cleaning Kit
item_short_desc: Rothco’s All Caliber Gun Cleaning Kit is an essential tool for firearm owners, providing everything needed for thorough maintenance. This versatile kit is designed to service most caliber firearms, ensuring that your weapon remains in optimal condition. The gun maintenance kit includes a chamber brush, a five-piece rod assembly, .22 cal bore brush, .30 cal bore brush, .45 cal bore brush, .357 cal bore brush, and cleaning patches, catering to a wide range of firearms.
description: Rothco’s All Caliber Gun Cleaning Kit is an essential tool for firearm owners, providing everything needed for thorough maintenance. This versatile kit is designed to service most caliber firearms, ensuring that your weapon remains in optimal condition. The gun maintenance kit includes a chamber brush, a five-piece rod assembly, .22 cal bore brush, .30 cal bore brush, .45 cal bore brush, .357 cal bore brush, and cleaning patches, catering to a wide range of firearms. Additionally, the cleaning kit comes with an empty oil bottle that you can fill with your preferred gun oil (oil not included). For easy storage and transport, the entire kit is packaged in a durable polyester MOLLE compatible belt pouch. This design allows you to conveniently carry the cleaning tools wherever you go, ensuring that your firearm maintenance kit is always within reach. Rothco’s All Caliber Gun Cleaning Kit combines practicality with durability, making it a must-have for any firearm enthusiast.
